beats.head: WHO'S OUR NO. 2?
beats.name: BARNES
beats.vo: We all know our number one. Scottie's the guy. But with Kawhi out, who's our number two?
beats.dlg: SCOTTIE'S OUR NO. 1.|SO WHO'S OUR NO. 2?

beats.head: NECK AND NECK
beats.name: BARRETT
beats.vo: It's RJ or I Q. RJ's at twenty-one point three a night through twelve games. I Q, seventeen point six through ten.

beats.head: THE CASE FOR RJ
beats.name: BARRETT
beats.vo: RJ gets downhill. Six point seven boards a night, and forty-six percent from the field.
beats.dlg: 6.7 REBOUNDS A NIGHT.|46.4% FROM THE FIELD.

beats.head: THE CASE FOR IQ
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: But I Q runs the show. Five point six assists, and just one turnover a night.

beats.head: THE KNOCKS
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: The knock on RJ? Sixty-two percent at the line. The knock on I Q? Forty percent from the field.
beats.dlg: RJ: 62.1% AT THE LINE.|IQ: 40.0% FROM THE FIELD.

beats.head: WHO'S NO. 2?
beats.vo: Two guards, two different games. Who's our number two? Comment below.

caption:
WHO'S OUR NO. 2? 🎮🏀 Scottie's the guy. With Kawhi out, it's RJ or IQ.

• RJ, 12 games: 21.3 PPG, 6.7 RPG, 46.4% from the field
• IQ, 10 games: 17.6 PPG, 5.6 APG, just 1.0 turnover a night
• The knock on RJ: 62.1% at the line
• The knock on IQ: 40.0% from the field
• Kawhi: 2 games so far this season

RJ or IQ? 👇

facts.claim: Kawhi Leonard: October 27, 2026: out with swelling in his left knee; back with Toronto 2026-present
Scottie Barnes leads the Raptors in scoring this season (No. 1 scorer, 23.5 PPG), ahead of RJ Barrett 21.3 and Immanuel Quickley 17.6
